notes.title: Celebrate the Season with a Great Deal and a Development Diary Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575531/f5849b9a3d2f1a2e9b38f526d8cac367aa492333.jpg[/img]

The Steam Winter Sale has officially begun, and you can grab G.I. JOE: WRATH OF COBRA at 20% off for a limited time!  If you haven’t joined the fight yet, now is the perfect time to jump in and experience the action. Catch the game on sale from [b]December 19th until January 2nd[/b]!

As the year wraps up, we want to thank you for your incredible support since launch. It’s been a busy few months for our small team as we’ve worked hard to roll out updates and fixes across PC and consoles, all based on your valuable feedback.

[b][h2]Hotfixes in the Latest Update:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Final Cutscene Subtitles:[/b] Subtitles are now properly displayed.
[*][b]Boss Defeat Soft Lock:[/b] Fixed errors that caused soft locks when bosses were defeated.
[*][b]Story Video Playback:[/b] Resolved an issue where story videos only played from level select and not post-level completion.
[*][b]Video Playback Soft Lock: [/b]Fixed an issue where videos could soft-lock players if not skipped.
[/list]
[b][h2]Previous Fixes: [/h2][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Control Rebinding: [/b]Custom control settings now save correctly, so you won’t need to reconfigure them after each session.
[*][b]Cutscene Skipping:[/b] No more accidental skipping of cutscenes.
[*][b]Dash Grabs: [/b]Dashing into grabbable objects or enemies won’t cancel your dash attack.
[*][b]Health Pickups:[/b] You can now grab health items without dropping your weapon.
[*][b]Boss Speed Fix:[/b] Bosses won’t slow down mid-fight, keeping the action fast-paced.
[*][b]Sprite Sheet Optimization[/b]: Visual artifacts from sprite sheets have been eliminated.
[/list]
[b][h2]Previous Quality-of-Life Improvements:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Higher Difficulty Tweaks: [/b]Harder difficulties are now even tougher for those seeking a challenge.
[*][b]Dark Duke Boss Fight:[/b] Improved gameplay flow and less spammy mechanics.
[*][b]More Floppies:[/b] Increased floppy drops, especially from minibosses.
[*][b]Ferret AI: [/b]Smarter behavior from Ferret enemies.
[*][b]Crimson Twins Boss Fight:[/b] Combat flow rebalanced for a more satisfying challenge.
[*][b]Timber AI:[/b] Timber now exits the battlefield more smoothly.
[/list]
[b][h2]What’s Next?[/h2][/b]
We’re continuing to refine and optimize based on your feedback, with a focus on stability improvements and performance optimizations to ensure the best experience possible. While multiplayer functionality has taken longer than we initially hoped, we’re actively working on it for all platforms, and aim to share an official update on its rollout in the New Year.

We also have been working on new content with three new playable characters, new shop items, and new game modes. These updates are progressing in parallel with the console versions, so stay tuned for more details! 

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your feedback has been invaluable and we’re excited for what’s next.

Want to be the first to know about upcoming updates, share your ideas, or connect with other players? Join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/aeMN3ZXqhU]Discord community[/url] and become part of the conversation!

We wish you a wonderful holiday season and look forward to bringing you even more exciting updates in the New Year.
[b]YO JOE![/b]
                
Make sure to check out other great indie games on sale during the [url=https://bit.ly/indieio_WinterSale2024]Winter Sale[/url] to add them to your collection.

notes.title: Patch 1 Notes
notes.content:
We’ve got an exciting update for Wrath of Cobra packed with fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Check out what's been enhanced in your mission to bring down Cobra!

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Control Rebinding: Your custom control settings will now save correctly, so you won’t need to reconfigure them after each session.
[*] Cutscene Skipping: Accidental skipping of cutscenes has been resolved.
[*] Dash Grabs: Dashing into grabbable objects or enemies will no longer cancel your dash attack.
[*] Health Pickup While Armed: You can now pick up health items without needing to drop your weapon.
[*] Boss Movement Speed: Bosses will no longer slow down mid-fight.
[*] Sprite Sheet Optimization: We've optimized the sprite sheet to prevent any visual artifacting.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Higher Difficulty Tweaks: Harder difficulties are now harder.
[*] Dark Duke Boss Fight: Dark Duke has undergone some improvements to make his fight more engaging and less spammy.
[*] More Floppies: Especially from minibosses.
[*] Ferret AI Improvements: The Ferret enemies are a bit smarter.
[*] Crimson Twins Boss Fight: The fight against the Crimson Twins has been refined for a more satisfying experience.
[*] Timber AI Enhancements: better able to leave the battlefield.
[/list]

Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates as we continue to improve the game. YO JOE!
